text:
elaine (PM): quick sync on compact autoscale flow - trying to land a version that fits dashboard rows but still exposes pool selection, burst, and SLO presets. preferences?
toby (Design): propose a two-line compact card: line 1 = min/max (two-handle) + small SLO badge, line 2 = presets + compact chevron for advanced. keeps height ~140px.
chen (Eng): Implementation note: if presets change min/max we should animate numeric badges only, not redraw whole slider, to avoid layout shift. Also debounce backend save by 800ms.
mira (Product): Important: pool selector must never be hidden when user is on a Dedicated account page. We should default to expanded pool row for enterprise orgs.
ricky (SRE): +1. Also guardrail: if user sets config that would exceed pool capacity, show inline warning and a disabled "Save" with tooltip "Reduce max or choose another pool". Avoid silent fallbacks for Dedicated.
toby (Design): Copy tweak: replace "Save" with "Apply capacity" in this flow to signal infra impact. And small hint under burst: "Burst capacity will be reclaimed when traffic subsides."
elaine (PM): What about confirmation modal for large changes? e.g., bumping max by >2x or enabling burst with >50% buffer. Should we require confirmation?
chen (Eng): We can add an escalation modal for those thresholds. Also log the action as an audit event with previous/next values.
lumen (a11y-bot): Accessibility nits: 1) ensure slider handles have accessible names like "Min instances" / "Max instances". 2) Provide a non-visual label for preset chips. 3) Announce warnings via aria-live polite.
toby (Design): UX nit: the pool picker dropdown is wide and pushes other controls. Suggest the picker opens overlay instead of expanding inline in compact mode. Also add a small pool summary chip (GPU type + zone) so users see current pool without opening picker.
mira (Product): For presets, add microcopy rationale: e.g., "Low latency: maintains p95 < 150ms at higher cost" so teams know tradeoffs. Also surface cost estimate next to preset (small text).
ricky (SRE): For guardrails, we should provide an opt-in "override" with required justification for account owners. Store override reason in audit logs.
chen (Eng): Keyboard interactions: left/right arrow should move the focused handle by 1 instance; shift+arrow by 10. Also provide +/- buttons next to counts for precise adjustments.
toby (Design): Visual: make the swap-values quick action (when min>max) a small inline button "Flip" next to the red pill. Use tooltip "Swap min and max".
elaine (PM): action items: toby - deliver compact + expanded mocks (Thu). chen - spike keyboard slider + overlay pool picker (Fri). lumen - a11y checklist on mocks. mira - draft preset rationales and cost text. ricky - define guardrail thresholds and override flow.
toby (Design): I'll also add contrast checks and provide alt text for preset icons.
elain (PM): tiny typo: my name is elaine :)
